摘要缺失

指向句子

问题是什么
The abstract is missing, so the first-page reader cannot recover the paper's problem, gap, idea, evidence, or boundary.
为什么有问题
The reader starts the paper without a map of what belief should change.
违反原则
改变读者理解状态; first-page reader test.
严重度理由
A missing abstract breaks first-page recoverability for a full-paper review.
置信度
high
降级条件
A complete abstract is added and matches the paper's actual evidence.
自改问题
Write an abstract that states problem, gap, idea, evidence, and boundary without increasing claim strength.

Table 1 数值口径不可复现

指向句子

问题是什么
In Table 1, the Method A signal reports 95.77 while the visible arithmetic mean of the preceding cells is 95.52; the manuscript must explain any weighted/micro aggregation before this can support the claim.
为什么有问题
A reader who recomputes the visible cells cannot reproduce the displayed summary value.
违反原则
不要让读者做算术题; explicit denominator and aggregation.
严重度理由
The affected number is in a main evidence table; the signal is concrete but aggregation may be weighted.
置信度
medium
核查依据
LaTeX tabular visible-cell arithmetic signal；scripts/extract_paper_text.py Table Numeric Recalculation Signals
降级条件
The paper documents a valid weighted/micro aggregation or updates the table.
自改问题
State the aggregation denominator/procedure or correct the visible summary value.
